as_told.title: Baiting UFOs with nuclear material and downing them with directed energy

plain: A secret Pentagon-funded program that studied UFO reports, known as AAWSAP, is said to have considered luring UFOs with nuclear material and then bringing them down with directed energy weapons and high-powered radar. Michels tells it twice on the show, citing Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official turned whistleblower who he says was involved in the program, and who wrote about it in his book Imminent, published in 2024; the second time Michels adds the directed energy and radar and names the book. If true, it would mean officials planned to actively capture these craft, not just watch them.
